title: wg: content-09 §5.11 sorts threads by a nonexistent timestamp field
description: §5.11 sorts a thread by 'the timestamp field', but mimiContent has no such field; presumably the §3.4 accepted timestamp. Fix: name the field. Found by the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18.
notes: 2026-10-21: verified vs a89298c; added to PR #84 (commit on MarkAtwood:editorial): 'uses the hub accepted timestamp (hubAcceptedTimestamp)'. Not built locally.
